name: model-router
description: Routes each subagent to the cheapest Claude model and effort that can do its task, judged by TypeSafe Jev

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: Your TypeSafe API key. The plugin sends it to TypeSafe only, as the bearer token of the scoring request. The README says where to get one.

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: suggest: log the model and effort Jev would pick, change nothing. auto: set the model and the effort. Only a model or effort passed in the Agent call is kept. Auto also overrides a model or effort pinned in an agent definition.
